column1: # Mandatory Stage 1 variants, parsed as data by tests/run.sh check-scenarios.
# Every variant needs at least one active scenario (a real registered case)
# in scenarios.tsv, referenced as variant:<name>. Never drop one silently.
# One variant = one property: a variant is carried by exactly one case, so
# deleting a case cannot hide behind a sibling that proves something else.
